|game_text=Deploy on Sidious. At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. During your move phase, relocate this Effect to a Rebel or Jedi at a battleground; that character loses all immunity to attrition. If this Effect just lost, relocate it to Sidious.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata versions are [[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). The images here (the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image) show this text; the errata texts are shown by CardMaker recreations on their pages.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Sidious. At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. During your move phase, relocate this Effect to a Rebel or Jedi at a battleground; that character loses all immunity to attrition. If this Effect just lost, relocate it to Sidious.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) moved “if at Senate” to the front: “At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw” became “If at Senate, at start of your turn may draw”. PC-E1 text: “Deploy on Sidious. If at Senate, at start of your turn may draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. During your move phase, relocate this Effect to a Rebel or Jedi at a battleground; that character loses all immunity to attrition. If this Effect just lost, relocate it to Sidious.”<ref name="cl-1250_22-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[With Thunderous Applause (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) restored the printed “At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw” and changed “loses all immunity to attrition” to “loses any immunity to attrition”. PC-E2 text: “Deploy on Sidious. At start of your turn, if at Senate, may draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. During your move phase, relocate this Effect to a Rebel or Jedi at a battleground; that character loses any immunity to attrition. If this Effect just lost, relocate it to Sidious.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
